draft.summary: Educational / decision guide for what-is-crm using block recipe for topicType=fundamental. Optimize for intent completeness — not word count.

sections.heading: Direct answer
sections.body: Answer the search intent in under 30 seconds. Prefer DirectAnswer + KeyTakeaways blocks.

sections.heading: Content block recipe
sections.body: Emit GuideContentBlock[] in this order (skip only with justification): direct-answer → key-takeaways → step → crm-types → faq → related-content → interactive-cta. Use HTML/CSS visual blocks (DecisionFramework, FeatureMatrix, CostBreakdown, Scorecard, etc.) — not decorative stock art. Never invent catalogue products; reference existing slugs only. Do not duplicate Best / Finder / Calculator pages — teach how to decide, then link upward.

sections.heading: Decision framework
sections.body: For selection/buying-guide topics: include interactive checklist, weighted criteria, trial plan, and Finder CTA. For fundamentals: diagram + how-it-works + examples. For implementation: timeline + checklists + risks.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.body: Call out buyer mistakes without inventing vendor claims.

sections.heading: Related tools and pages
sections.body: Link Learn → Best/Pricing → Finder → Compare/Review → vendor. Affiliate status never sets order.

faq.question: Is this guide page based on live vendor verification?
faq.answer: Only approved/verified facts and pricing-engine outputs in the brief may be cited. Fixture research is not live vendor truth.
